description: This file is a template header for the CMSIS-RTOS API, defining constants, types, and function prototypes for RTOS features such as threads, timers, semaphores, mutexes, message queues, and system tick functions. It provides an interface for RTOS operations and is intended for use with Zephyr RTOS integration.

methods.name: osKernelInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the RTOS kernel for creating objects.

methods.name: osKernelRunning
methods.description: Checks if the RTOS kernel is already started.

methods.name: osKernelSysTick
methods.description: Returns the system timer counter value.

methods.name: osKernelSysTickMicroSec
methods.description: Converts microseconds to system timer ticks.

methods.name: osThreadDef
methods.description: Defines a thread with function, priority, stack size, and other parameters.

methods.name: osThreadCreate
methods.description: Creates a new thread based on a thread definition.

methods.name: osThreadGetId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the current thread.

methods.name: osThreadYield
methods.description: Yields execution to the next thread.

methods.name: osThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of a thread.

methods.name: osThreadGetPriority
methods.description: Gets the priority of a thread.

methods.name: osDelay
methods.description: Delays thread execution for specified milliseconds.

methods.name: osWait
methods.description: Waits for signal, message, mail, or timeout.

methods.name: osTimerDef
methods.description: Defines a timer with callback function.

methods.name: osSignalSet
methods.description: Sets signal flags for a thread.

methods.name: osSignalClear
methods.description: Clears signal flags for a thread.

methods.name: osSignalWait
methods.description: Waits for signal flags to be set.
